subject: storytime
title: Giraffes Can't Dance words
about: Gerald the giraffe has long, wobbly legs and gets laughed at when he tries to join the big jungle dance, until a friendly cricket helps him hear music of his own. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, then make up a dance of your own at the end.

book.author: Giles Andreae
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A clumsy giraffe finds his own song and shows the whole jungle how to dance.

cards.note: capital G, it is his name; the g says j before e; the a says u: Jer-uld
the g says j; ir says a short, quick er; ff is one f; the e at the end is quiet: jer-af
ng is one part; le says ul: jung-gul
the i says its name and the o says u: lye-un
c-r blend; ck is one sound; two parts: crick-et
oo says long oo, like in zoom
two parts: mu-sic; the u says its name, like you, and the s says z: myoo-zik
kn says n, the k is quiet; ee says long e; the s says z: neez
au says short a here and gh says f: laf
ce at the end says s: dans
t-w blend; ir says er, like in bird
ea says long e, like in eat
s-w blend; ng is one part
g-r blend; ss is one sound
